text.description_html:
Acorn GL2BG-D, Decorative Matte Black 14" x 5-1/2" Cast Iron Register with Louver

The 14 Inch x 5-1/2 Inch Cast Iron Register Without Screw Holes has louvers so you can adjust the airflow. It is made from solid cast iron, which makes it durable. Crafted with care with careful attention to product design, this cast iron register is made with the high caliber craftsmanship that has made Acorn the choice of architects, designers and homeowners throughout the world. This register is designed to fit snugly into heading ducts and comes packaged with all necessary mounting hardware.

Also available without screw holes and screws.

Features of the Matte Black Cast Iron Registers with Louver:

  • Material: solid cast iron.
  • Traditional matte black finish.
  • Easy to install.
  • Comes packaged mouthing hardware.

Specifications of the Fancy Iron Registers:

  • Overall Length: 14"
  • Overall Width: 5-1/2"
  • Inner Lip Length: 12"
  • Inner Lip Width: 4"

Sold Individually.
